review_evidence: README describes Violet as a programming language centered on dependent types, effects, semantic versioning and separate compilation.

The 16 Lean files contain the object-language syntax (including dependent Pi/Sigma terms), environments/values, normalization-by-evaluation style evaluation/quotation, unification, and bidirectional inference/checking machinery.

Although this snapshot has no theorem/lemma declarations, the core AST/evaluator/elaborator are substantive formal language definitions and constructions; under FILTER-001/002 there is no lossless basis for removing them from prior-work search.
summary: Reviewed violet-legacy; retain its dependently typed language syntax, evaluator, elaborator, and unification constructions.
